description: Run XPath 1.0 queries over XML you supply (RSS/Atom, SOAP, sitemaps, SVG, config) or over HTML for scraping: returns matched elements/attributes/text with their paths, text, attributes and outer markup, or the number/string/boolean result of an expression. Namespaces are auto-registered (default namespace as prefix d). Safe parser: no network, no external entities, DTD entities rejected. POST JSON body {xml or html, xpath}. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/xml-xpath

html.description: HTML document (lenient parser), alternative to xml

outerXml.description: Include each element's markup (truncated to 2000 chars)

name: xml_xpath
title: Xml Xpath
